'''Doraise Mesianos''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is plump.

==History==
Although unconfirmed, her melodious surname ending in ''-os'' suggests an [[Illianer]] origin.

She has a [[Shienaran]] [[Warder]].

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

[[Alviarin Freidhen]] suggests that [[Elaida a'Roihan]] reward her, along with [[Farellien]] and [[Kiyoshi]], while simultaneously punishing [[Josaine]] and [[Adelorna Bastine]], who held ''[[angreal]]'' and ''[[ter'angreal]]'' without the [[Tower]]'s permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs{{Ref/book|7|32}}.

She is seen walking the corridors of the White Tower with [[Marris Thornhill]], who had already been identified as [[Black Ajah]] by the [[Black Ajah Hunters]], and newly-raised [[Elin Warrel]].
